subject: The secret feature 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: You've been using the app for 3 weeks. If you haven't tried this one thing, you're doing it the hard way.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was looking at the usage data this morning, and I saw something that made me facepalm. You've had the app for 22 days. You're probably generating thesis statements, maybe even outlines. But there's a single button almost everyone ignores for the first month. And it's the one that saves people from all-nighters.

It's the difference between building your paper manually, brick by stressful brick, and having the foundation laid for you in 60 seconds. The students who find this feature? They stop panicking about blank pages. They get that competitive edge because they're not just writing; they're structuring genius-level arguments from the get-go.

It's the 'Outline to Full Paper' engine. You feed it your thesis, and it doesn't just give bullet points. It auto-generates the logical flow, suggests data points for graphs, and plants placeholders for citations that actually make sense. It turns your 10-minute thesis into a 30-minute draft. No more staring.

Open Thesis Generator. Tap 'New Paper' and then hit 'Generate Full Draft'. See what happens. Don't just take my word for it—see how fast the panic dissolves. P.S. The first time you use it, check the citations tab. It pre-fills them in your chosen style. You're welcome.
